decisions.reason: The flagship management platform anchors the agency-focused strategy and has shown no evidence of failure, so it is a core commitment that warrants further investment rather than abandonment.
The configurable managed plan still has a page of its own and runs cheaply on owned infrastructure, so keeping the option open costs little while demand evidence accumulates.

Extended PHP security support is new, fits the security and compliance direction, and costs little to maintain, though its value may shrink as legacy PHP versions phase out, so it stays as a low-cost option for now.
